correctness.rationale: The backward equation gives the exact weighted reciprocal-diffusivity MFPT. The standard diffusion metric gives the fixed-profile fastest-arrival constant. Strict convexity and the exact Euler multiplier produce unique global scalarized minimizers; the quartic substitution integrates to normalized d_r and exact logarithmic costs. Strict scalar ordering, Jensen and Cauchy–Schwarz prove completeness including both endpoints. For the singular mean endpoint, an explicit transformed squared-Bessel generator and Bessel Laplace transform prove the correct short-time exponent 8/27 and hence the endpoint extreme-time constant. The delivered standard-library checker passed 177 deterministic numerical/algebraic checks; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Primary source Menon (2026) proves the standalone MFPT optimum but not a simultaneous cost frontier; Lawley proves the fixed-profile first-arrival law but not joint fixed-budget design. The new statement characterizes all and only Pareto-efficient diffusivity profiles, gives exact quartic/logarithmic costs, proves strict total ordering and a sharp mean–extreme endpoint tradeoff, and handles the singular endpoint separately. Actual related published-finding corpus entries and recovered own claims cover other metrics or regimes, not a stronger covering profile classification. Novelty remains qualified by possible implicit prior variational duality.
residual_risks: Related general variational design theory might implicitly formulate the same bicriterion cost frontier; semantic retrieval and paper comparisons do not prove global priority.
The 2022 inverse-time search-efficiency primary paper was not fully retrieved; its explicit objective is different and its abstract does not reveal a dominating theorem.
Physical leading-N interpretation is a fixed-profile asymptotic; finite-N and profile-dependent uniformity are deliberately outside this claim.

value.rationale: A single budgeted spatial diffusion must often serve both a lone searcher and a large independently searching population. Their natural optimality targets differ (mean reciprocal diffusivity versus squared intrinsic distance), and a single-objective mean optimizer worsens the collective objective by the exact 32/27 factor. The complete, unique one-parameter classification and sharp endpoint tradeoff enable quantitative design choice for every efficient compromise; this is a motivated continuous variational classification, not a renamed standard formula or arbitrary numerical slice.
